title: Minneapolis Police Incidents
description: Police incident reports from the Minneapolis Police Department: offense, description, precinct, neighborhood, public block address, dates and coordinates. Filter by year, date, offense or neighborhood.
why: Crime by block and type, straight from the city's incident file, for safety scores, site selection and reporting.
useCases: Real-estate and insurance analysts scoring blocks
Security companies and retailers doing site selection

year.title: Year
year.description: Which year's incident file to read.

reportedSince.title: Reported on or after (YYYY-MM-DD)
reportedSince.description: Only incidents reported on or after this date.

limits: Addresses are block-level as MPD publishes them. No victim or suspect data exists in the source.
